column3: The issue view's State and Priority pickers are UI SDK Menus with a radio group (close-on-select), mounted only while open
column4: The migration table maps the issue menu to Menu; unmounting on close resets the radio group to the issue's value if an update fails, so no imperative write is needed
column5: e2e: Enter on State opens four radio items with In progress checked, choosing Done sends one issue.update and focus returns to the picker
